notes.text: Arrived at settled 2026-10-05. Left in hapi: the MANAGE_BILLING action and SUBSCRIPTION resource constants (MANAGE_BILLING survives only as the can.spec example of an action no rule grants), the organization assertions moved to src/lib/access at fenced (the organization sector's to take), the billing migrations and the drop, and the marker. Outside the repo: Stripe's webhook endpoint must point at the gateway's /api/webhooks/stripe, which now rewrites to the Nest server.

Left in the Nest server: the billing ACL adapters reading public.memberships, public.organization_roles and public.roles with the legacy row schemas they use, the legacy-row test seeds, and billing.subscriptions' missing FK to organizations; all of it goes when organization and role move. The shared scaffolding (proxy, mirror plugin, mirror events) left with billing's last use; the next sector restores it under the shared globs.
